title: Lingering Scent
text: “Nice to meet you.”
My father greets the soldier sent by the government. The soldier salutes and holds the reins of that creature.
“Growl.”
That creature is getting agitated by my presence and by seeing Yuki-chan and the others.
“Come on, Motoyasu-kun.”
“I know, I know…”
Fighting off a chill, I took a step forward with trembling legs, grabbed my Father’s hand as he mounted that creature, and climbed aboard.
“Grrraa!”
“Hey! Behave yourself!”
That creature… the flying dragon shook its back in annoyance, but the soldier managed to calm it down.
“It seems Sakura and the others aren’t compatible with it, so they can’t ride it.”
“Ehh… Sakura, I want to protect Naofumi.”
“It’ll be fine. Sakura-chan, just stay on the ground and protect everyone.”
“Okay! Sakura will protect everyone!”
Sakura-chan replied firmly at Father’s words.
“We’re going to cast Ceremonial Magic to support Lord Motoyasu! Now, everyone, get ready.”

At Yuki-chan’s command, Filolial-sama and the others let out a low growl. As I watched them, the flying dragon flapped its wings and floated gently into the air. Ah, why is Filo-tan the only one of the Filolial-sama who can fly? I wish Filo-tan would take this Motoyasu up into the sky with those magnificent angel wings of hers.

I, Motoyasu, should be able to ascend to heaven in a dreamlike state, but right now, an itch is slowly spreading from between my thighs. I must get off the flying dragon before chills, hives, and a rash take over my entire body. Come to think of it, isn’t my beloved Filo-tan’s father right in front of me? Clinging to him might take my mind off things a little.
“Whoa! Motoyasu-kun. Where are you putting your hands!?”
Hugging her Father from behind, I focus my mind.
“Don’t sniff my neck! I’m not gay—that’s gross!”
“Ugh… Filo-tan…”
Oh, I think I can faintly smell Filo-tan’s lingering scent on Father. Sniff, sniff!
“Eh, uh… Motoyasu-kun, stop it! Don’t sniff me! Eww! Did you just lick me? Please, snap out of it!”

-Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan!
“Waaaaaah! Someone, please bring Motoyasu-kun back to his senses!”
“Grrr!”
At the roar of the flying dragon, I instantly sensed hostility.
“Hah!”
“Motoyasu-kun, are you back to your senses?”
“I feel like I can catch a whiff of Filo-tan on my Father.”
“Motoyasu, please stop losing your mind in a place like this! Besides, the scent on me is Sakura-chan’s, right? She was riding on my back just a moment ago.”
Hmm… that’s right. It seems we’re flying quite high in the sky now. Yuki-chan and the others on the ground look so tiny.
“Motoyasu-kun!”
My father calls out to me, and I focus my attention. Five airplanes ahead… they’re charging toward us in formation. Little by little, I’m starting to forget that I’m riding a flying dragon.
Those pigs—the remnants of Takt’s forces—are on board those planes. Just thinking that gets me fired up. With a “baba-baba” sound, bullets are fired from the airplanes.
“Airst Feather Shield V!”

My father deploys the shield to protect us from the enemy’s attack. Meanwhile, the planes are charging toward us and trying to turn. They’re Takt’s remnants… their levels must be pretty high. I’m not sure if I can take them all out with the Aiming Lancer, and Gungnir can only take down one at a time… It’s a tricky situation.

But I, Motoyasu, am up for the challenge. Look, there’s one coming in for a well-timed charge right at us. I’ll raise my spear and take aim. Come to think of it, there’s an attack that comes in handy at times like this. That skill—which I’ve used less often since learning Brionac—is about to really shine.
“Meteor Thrust X!”

Meteor Thrust… It’s a skill that, when unleashed, flies through the air strewn with sparkling stars, just like a shooting star. Starting with the Meteor Sword of Ren, the Meteor Thrust follows in that same lineage, also strewn with stars. It’s a skill I’ve used against my Father in the past. Although he managed to block it back then, it’s a skill where the stars strike as a follow-up after the initial direct attack.

This time, I used the Meteor Thrust to hit one plane as it flew past, and the stars struck the other two that were within its range. An area-of-effect attack with higher firepower than the Aiming Lancer—what do you think? The plane hit by the Thrust exploded in a red flash.

I felt a solid impact, and then the stars from the Meteor Thrust streaked at high speed toward the other two planes. Spewing smoke, those two also gradually lost altitude before exploding. I wonder if their fuel caught fire?
“Two more to go, Motoyasu-kun! Hang in there!”
“Yes, sir!”
With two planes left, there’s only one thing to do. I’ll raise my spear and lock onto the targets. A high-damage skill specialized in accuracy!
“Gungnir X!”
The spear flew forward with great force and pierced one of the planes.
“Good!”
Father gave a fist pump. The last plane is charging straight toward us. This is a suicide attack. Father held his shield forward and cast a skill.
“Air One-Way Shield!”

Something like a mass of wind materialized in front of us, causing the flying dragon to adjust its posture and hover in place. Ahead of it, the attacking plane charged in… and was swept upward while spinning sideways like a tornado.
“It’s a skill that creates a wind shield to force a change of direction. Motoyasu! Finish it off!”
“Understood.”
I’m a bit worried about the accuracy when firing Brionac. I’ll go with Magic here. I focused my mind and cast the spell while raising my spear toward the sky.
“Liberation Firestorm X!”

A fiery tornado formed at the tip of my spear and shot forward. Father’s air shield sucked in the flames, and the fiery tornado I cast grew massive, incinerating the last remaining aircraft. The clouds overhead vanished in the blink of an eye, and the area was suddenly bathed in blinding, scorching sunlight.
“Whoa… Motoyasu. Wouldn’t it have been faster to cast that Magic than to take them out one by one with your Skills?”
“I don’t think I could’ve taken them all out at once.”
It would’ve been tough to aim if they’d started maneuvering.
“Alright, the bombing should have stopped now. While Motoyasu-kun’s still holding it together… let’s hurry and descend!”
“Yes, sir!”
Following Father’s orders, the Dragon Cavalry hurriedly began their descent toward the ground.
“Ugh… my whole body is itching!”
I climbed down from the flying dragon and started scratching the spots where I had hives. Now that I’m back on the ground, it feels like the itching has subsided a bit.
“Next… are there any remnants of Takt’s forces on the battlefield?”
“Reports indicate there are currently none among the vanguard of the Shieldfreeden Army.”
At the operations command center, my Father asked urgently.
“Got it. Do you think we can get them to retreat somehow?”
“It’s going to be tough.”
The representative of the Shusaku clan replied, clearly struggling to say it. My Father and I handled the situation in the air, but it seems things are difficult on this front.

“Part of the reason is that those lowly creatures are frenzied because their object of worship was killed, but since the leader of the Aotatsu race in Shieldfreeden has issued orders, they’re doing everything they can to prevent a retreat…”
“I see…”
“However, our nation has the edge in close-quarters combat, so we won’t let them force us into a battle we can’t win.”
“Got it. Let me know if anything happens. If anyone from Takt attacks, I’ll join the fight too!”
“Ha!”
Just then, a soldier came running over.
“Emergency!”
“What is it?!”
“The Melromarc Army, which had been lying low, has entered the battle!”
“Damn… at a time like this… no, they attacked precisely because it’s a time like this!”
“Confirming the Melromarc Army’s formation! The Wise King of Wisdom is in the rear, and at the forefront, the Pope of the Three Heroes Church is advancing while brandishing a mysterious weapon!”
“A mysterious weapon!? What on earth is that?”
“Well… I believe it’s a replica of one of the Four Holy Weapons said to have been used in the past!”

Come to think of it, the Pope did have a weapon like that. It certainly qualifies as a powerful weapon. That weapon… It was so powerful that if my Father hadn’t taken it down with his “Cursed Shield” skill, I think we would have been defeated back then. At that point, anyway.
“Motoyasu… what should we do about this? My read on the situation is that we should leave the Shieldfreeden army to Siltvelt and focus on the Melromarc army instead.”

Hmm… what should we do? As my father says, we can’t ignore that Trash and the Pope. They were probably planning to launch an attack in cooperation with Shieldfreeden. However, we’ve likely shot down all of Shieldfreeden’s trump card—their airplanes. It’s safe to assume they had already launched their attack by the time the order came in.
“You’re right. Well then, Father, let’s head toward the Melromarc army.”
